title: paperpush venue list
description: Schema for venues.json, the master venue list. The top-level object maps a venue slug to its general metadata. Generated from the VenueInfo dataclass in paperpush/database.py; run scripts/gen_venues_schema.py to regenerate.

propertyNames.description: Venue slug. The canonical identifier is the lowercase slug; case variants collapse to one venue at load time.

name.description: Display name. Defaults to the slug when omitted.

venue_type.description: Kind of venue: a preprint server, a journal, or a conference.

anonymous.description: Anonymous (double-blind) review: validate checks the attached files and linked anonymous.4open.science repositories for information identifying the authors.

deprecated.description: Hidden from listings but still reachable by get_venue.
